test_inputs.explanation: The execution trace only exposes the URLs visited (Magento admin customer grid), not the concrete form values. However, to successfully reach and operate on the customer grid at /admin/customer/index/, the agent must have logged into the Magento Admin first with some credentials and then performed a mass action. Since those concrete credentials and choices are not visible in the trace, standard Magento demo/admin defaults and typical mass-action flows were used to create working, realistic test inputs: a common admin credential pair ('admin'/'admin123'), selecting all visible customers ('select_visible'), performing an 'Assign a Customer Group' mass action, assigning them to the 'General' group, and then applying a Group filter of 'General' to verify the result. These values conform to the provided schema and should allow someone to exercise the tool end-to-end against a typical Magento admin setup.
